name: Authorization UM6.1 -Denied Authorization on File Navigator
description: Walk the Authorization (UM) SOP for the PX_UM6 event -there is a denied authorization on file for one or more lines on the claim. Identify the PX_UM6 event, confirm the UM Rule ID is not one of the four flagged IDs, confirm the provider is not a Hospital Based Physician, run the eight Claim-Lines exclusion checks, confirm the claim type, verify the on-file authorization matches the billed service (Case Number UM93664160), expand the Authorization record and confirm its Status is Denied for all services and dates billed, then deny the claim with reject code PX_R23100.

steps.name: Review all events and identify the PX_UM6 event
steps.description: Review all events in the Event Resolution tab, including informational events, before paying, denying, or routing the claim when multiple events are set. The PX_UM6 event will be displayed in the events list -this Authorization event occurs when there is a denied authorization on file for one or more lines on the claim.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Event Resolution tab and reviews the events list, where the PX_UM6 event is shown.
steps.hint: Open 'Event Resolution' and review the events list. The active PX_UM6 event is shown -there is a denied authorization on file for one or more lines on the claim.
steps.checklistItem: Review all events and identify the PX_UM6 event

steps.name: Check the UM Rule ID
steps.description: Determine whether the UM Rule ID is one of the following: MMS001, PSYCH001, ASCRULE01, or NYSTATE02. Navigate to the Claim Data tab, then the Review sub-tab, and expand the Utilization Management section. Review the UM Detail Service table, which contains the Line #, Procedure, Revenue Code, Date, Rule ID, and Case Number columns, and identify the value displayed in the Rule ID column. If the Rule ID matches any of the specified values (MMS001, PSYCH001, ASCRULE01, or NYSTATE02), follow the alternate SOP steps. If none of these Rule IDs is present, proceed to the next step. In this scenario, the Rule ID is INPAT001, which does not match any of the specified values; therefore, the trainee may proceed to the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Review sub-tab inside Claim Data and reads the UM Detail Service table's Rule ID.
steps.hint: Open 'Claim Data' → 'Review' and expand Utilization management. The UM Detail Service Rule ID is INPAT001 -not one of MMS001 / PSYCH001 / ASCRULE01 / NYSTATE02 -so proceed.

steps.name: Check for a Hospital Based Physician
steps.description: Verify whether the provider billed on the claim qualifies as a Hospital Based Physician by navigating to the Provider Information tab, then the Rendering section, and reviewing the Specialty Description field. A provider is considered a Hospital Based Physician if the Specialty Description is Anesthesiology, Radiology, Emergency Room Physician, Pathology, Assistant Surgeon, Neonatology, Intensivist, or Hospitalist. If the provider is identified as a Hospital Based Physician, follow the alternate SOP steps. If the provider does not fall within one of these specialties, proceed to the next step. In this scenario, the Specialty Description is Cardiology; therefore, the provider is not considered a Hospital Based Physician, and the trainee may proceed to the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Provider Information tab to read the Rendering Speciality Description.
steps.hint: Open 'Provider Info' and read the Speciality description under Rendering -it is Cardiology, not a Hospital Based Physician specialty, so proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Check for a Hospital Based Physician

steps.name: Run the Claim Lines exclusion checks
steps.description:
On the Claim Lines tab, check eight exclusion conditions against the claim line. For this claim, the line shows Procedure 92928, Modifier "—", and POS 21.

For each check, if the condition matches, follow the alternate SOP steps. Otherwise, proceed to the next check.
Consulting Physician -Procedure code is 99231–99233 or 99251–99255. (92928 → no match)

Modifier 26 -Modifiers field equals 26. ("—" → no match)

Implants -Procedure code starts with C or L. (92928 → no match)

PAP / CPAP / BIPAP machines or supplies -Procedure code starts with E. (92928 → no match)

Chiropractic with PT, or PT alone -Procedure code is A2000–A2999. (92928 → no match)

Emergency Room or Urgent Care -POS is 23 (ER) or 20 (Urgent Care). (21 → no match)

Ambulance services -POS is 41 or 42. (21 → no match)

Drug administration -Procedure code is J0000–J8999. (92928 → no match)
In this scenario, none of the eight conditions match, so the trainee proceeds.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Claim Lines tab to run the eight exclusion checks against the Procedure, Modifiers, and POS fields.
steps.hint: Open 'Claim Lines'. Procedure 92928 (not 99231–99255 / C / L / E / A2xxx / J-code), Modifier '-' (not 26), and POS 21 (not 23/20/41/42) -none of the eight exclusions match, so proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Run the Claim Lines exclusion checks

steps.name: Check the claim type against the SOP table
steps.description: Determine whether the claim falls under a scenario defined in the UM Events Authorization SOP by navigating to the Claim Data tab, then the Details sub-tab, and reviewing the Claim Type field. Compare the Claim Type value against the scenarios listed in the UM Events Authorization SOP table. If the value matches a scenario in the table, follow the corresponding SOP instructions for that scenario. If the value does not match any listed scenario, proceed to the next step. In this scenario, the Claim Type is Professional, which does not correspond to a scenario requiring special handling; therefore, the trainee may proceed to the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Details sub-tab inside Claim Data to read the claim type.
steps.hint: Open 'Claim Data' → 'Details' and read the claim type -it is Professional, which is not one of the SOP-table scenarios, so proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Check the claim type against the SOP table

steps.name: Verify the authorization match
steps.description: Verify whether a matching authorization exists for the claim line(s) requiring authorization by navigating to the Claim Data tab, then the Review sub-tab, and expanding the Utilization Management section. Review the UM Detail Service table and examine the Case Number column for the applicable claim line(s). A valid Case Number indicates that a matching authorization exists. A value of NO MATCH indicates that an authorization exists but does not correspond to the billed service. A blank Case Number field indicates that no authorization exists. In this scenario, the Case Number field displays UM93664160, indicating that a matching authorization exists for the services billed. Therefore, the trainee may proceed to determine the authorization decision.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Review sub-tab inside Claim Data and reads the UM Detail Service table's Case Number.
steps.hint: Open 'Claim Data' → 'Review' and read the Case Number in the UM Detail Service table -it shows UM93664160 (an authorization exists and matches the billed services), so proceed to check the authorization decision.

steps.name: Expand the Authorization section and confirm Status Denied
steps.description: Determine the authorization decision -approved, partially approved, or denied -from the Status field in the Authorization section under the Review sub-tab of the Claim Data tab. Expand the Authorization section to display its seven fields: Authorization #, Date Range, Procedure, Provider, Status, Svc type, and Score. In this scenario the row shows UM93664160, Date Range 04/28/2026–07/29/2026, Procedure 92928, Provider Hailey, Status Denied, Svc type Medical, and Score 65%. If the Status is Approved or Partially Approved, follow the alternate SOP steps; if the Status is Denied -meaning the authorization has been denied for all services and dates of service billed on the claim, which is the reason the PX_UM6 event was fired -proceed to deny the claim. In this scenario, the Status is Denied, so the trainee proceeds.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee expands the Authorization row (which dispatches the expand_authorization action) and confirms the Status is Denied.
steps.hint: On 'Claim Data' → 'Review', click the chevron on the Authorization row to expand it. The Status is Denied -the authorization is denied for all services and dates billed -so proceed to deny the claim.
steps.checklistItem: Expand the Authorization section and confirm Status Denied

steps.name: Deny the claim using Reject code PX_R23100
steps.description: Apply reject code PX_R23100 as defined in the SOP for the denied-authorization rejection. From the Action menu, select Deny Claim. A new Deny Claim section will appear below the header. Enter reject code PX_R23100 in the input box -the matching code will appear in a dropdown list -select it and click Submit.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee submits the Deny Claim panel (which dispatches the deny_claim action).
steps.hint: Action menu → Deny Claim. Enter reject code PX_R23100 in the Deny Claim section, click Submit, then confirm the pop-up.
steps.checklistItem: Deny the claim using Reject code PX_R23100

steps.name: Submit Deny decision
steps.description: Navigate to the Decision section in the header, select 'Deny' from the dropdown menu and click Submit.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee confirms the Deny decision in the submit dialog.
steps.hint: Pick 'Deny' from the Decision dropdown in the claim header, then click Submit and confirm in the dialog.
